_comment: Single source of truth for the beehiiv migration warm-up schedule algorithm. All numeric values are derived directly from the migration-warmup SKILL.md tables and worked examples. See migration_warmup_spec.md for how each fuzzy rule in the skill was made deterministic.

cadence_map._comment: Normalized cadence keyword -> sends_per_week. Match is done on a lowercased, stripped string against the longest matching key. 'irregular' and 'monthly' set flags handled in code.

cadence_flags._comment: Cadences that require a CSM-review note appended to the output.
cadence_flags.monthly: Monthly cadence produces a very slow ramp - flag for CSM review.
cadence_flags.irregular: Irregular cadence treated as 1x/week - confirm true send frequency with customer.
cadence_flags.bi-weekly: Bi-weekly cadence: each send event is a 2-week block; calendar duration is ~2x the week count.

approach_multipliers._comment: Applied to every per-import batch size before cap enforcement and rounding. Conservative shrinks batches (so the engine naturally adds weeks); aggressive grows them (so the engine naturally compresses), while caps are always enforced.

approach_rules._comment: Deterministic selection. Evaluated top to bottom; first match wins, except aggressive which is only chosen after comparing the standard timeline to the deadline.
approach_rules.conservative_if: open_rate is None OR open_rate < 0.30 OR deliverability_concern == True
approach_rules.aggressive_if: NOT conservative AND deadline_weeks is not None AND deadline_weeks < standard_week_count

rounding_ladder._comment: round_clean(x): snap a batch size to a clean granularity by magnitude. Keeps outputs human-readable and deterministic.

limits._comment: Safety bound to guarantee termination. Engine raises if exceeded (e.g. monthly cadence on a huge list).
